content: [Task: 10_1186_s12915_024_01879_0_v1] [Author: proposer] [Category: method_plans] Task 9 (10_1186_s12915_024_01879_0_v1) 14-artifact method plan grounded via Exa: (1) Merge technical SRR runs per GSM biological sample (28 SRRs -> 16 GSMs) BEFORE clipping. content: [Task: 10.1101_2025.06.17.659900_v1] [Author: proposer] [Category: method_plans] Task 1 (10.1101_2025.06.17.659900_v1) 12-artifact method plan grounded via Exa: (1) RNA-seq: Align paired-end 50bp TruSeq stranded mRNA reads (ERR13767139..ERR13767144) to WS235 genome and quantify against c_elegans.WS235.annotations.gff2.gz using HTSeq-count (--stranded=reverse --mode=union --type=exon --idattr=gene_id). CRITICAL ID NAMESPACE RULE: rna_seq_htseq_counts_matrix.tsv uses exact WS235 GFF2 gene_id strings (e.g. 21ur-1, AC3.12), whereas let418_upregulated_de.tsv, let418_downregulated_de.tsv, and ipr_genes_upregulated_in_let418.tsv MUST be keyed by wormbase_gene_id (WBGene000xxxxx) with gene_name as second column! Canonical IPR genes (pals-5, F26F2.1, skr-4, skr-5, hsp-17 from Reddy et al. 2019 80-gene list) are strongly upregulated in let-418 mutant. (3) Nanopore DamID: Map single-end FASTQs (ERR14366752..ERR14366757) to WS235 with minimap2 -ax map-ont, retain MAPQ >= 30 where both alignment ends lie within +-8 bp of a genomic GATC motif, run damidseq_pipeline --bamfiles --extend_reads=0 pairing Rep1 with GFP-Dam_int_Rep1 and Rep2 with GFP-Dam_int_Rep2, average replicate tracks with average_tracks.pl, call peaks with find_peaks (FDR < 0.05), and assign peaks within +-2,000 bp of WS235 GFF2 gene features (target_gene_id = WS235 gene_id; palsoverlap = public pals-* gene_name).
